claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show 'Nikon D810' text on the body, not D610; this is a different model with different market value.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a Nikon logo, not Canon.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows visible scuffing and wear on the top plate and worn/dusty hot shoe contacts.
No battery, charger, or box is visible in any photo; claim text is also cut off.

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown, critical for DSLR valuation
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, fungus) not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sensor with lens removed under light, or a test photo at small aperture showing spots

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch between seller's words (D610) and photographed body (D810) raises doubt about which camera will actually ship
risks.proof: Clear photo of serial number plate and a video panning the body matching the listing
risks.if_unproven: price at worst case for lower-spec/uncertain model until confirmed

risks.risk: Included accessories (lens, battery, charger, strap, case) not shown
risks.proof: Photo of full bundle laid out together

risks.risk: Functional faults (autofocus, buttons, LCD, memory card slots) cannot be assessed from stills
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, menu navigation, shutter firing, and live view

risks.risk: Internal electronic faults or corrosion not visible externally
risks.proof: Video of camera operating continuously for a few minutes, including flash/exposure test

proof_requests: Clear photo of the serial number plate on the camera body
Video walkthrough: power on, menu showing shutter count, autofocus test, shutter firing sound
Photo of sensor with lens removed, in good light
Photo of all included accessories laid out together (battery, charger, lens, strap, case)
Clarification of actual model and brand to resolve mismatch with seller's text
response.reason: The seller's description names a different brand (Canon) and a different model (D610) than what the witness clearly saw (Nikon D810), a core identity mismatch that is a strong scam indicator and must be resolved before any price is set.
